## Context / Problem
The 17 `infra/gerrit` files below contain repeated, obvious, historical, or stale prose identified by the comment audit and revalidated on `origin/main` at `c019920390926d543a0813d4c0c8721543d98776`. Shortening it must preserve the live Gerrit security and delivery model.

## Approach
Edit only standalone comments and blank lines in the declared files. Preserve executable/configuration text byte-for-byte. Replace narration with the minimum current rationale needed by each consumer; describe known behavior gaps truthfully rather than strengthening claims.

## Scope
- `feature-branch-e2e-scenarios.sh` — Preserve sourced-driver API, `EVIDENCE:` schema, actual scenario assertions, and optional ACL probes. State accurately that scenario 4 records but does not assert Verified rerun and scenario 7 cites concurrency/backfill evidence only.
- `feature-branch-e2e.sh` — Preserve live/manual destructive scope, credential-helper auth without password URLs, exit meanings, mirror-ref wait before CI dispatch, DCO hook, sourced scenarios, and cleanup. Do not claim cleanup reverts content already merged to main.
- `feature-branch-inventory.sh` — Preserve 14-day default, ancestor-of-main classification, read-only default, explicit confirmed deletion on Gerrit and GitHub, and credential-helper inputs.
- `gerrit_to_platform.ini.template` — Preserve single-placeholder rendering, 0600 output, adjacent `replication.config`, `recheck -> verify`, branch-agnostic dispatch, and pre-existing mirror branch requirement. Remove the stale claim that current CI workflows run on `feature/**`.
- `install-plugins.sh` — Preserve two plugin identities, checksum-pinned provenance, manifest/on-disk names, cross-platform hashing, checksum idempotence, bounded download, atomic move, and OAuth-before-boot/restart requirement.
- `materialize-deploy-key.sh` — Preserve root/instance-role execution, exact SSM parameter, empty-value failure, UID/GID 1000, restrictive modes, secret nonlogging, deduplicated `known_hosts`, container paths, and strict host checking.
- `materialize-g2p-config.sh` — Preserve fail-closed SSM PAT handling, UID/GID/modes, safe shell substitution, copied cross-namespace replication config, stale-link removal, and missing-config warning. Do not claim direct destination writes are atomic.
- `project.config` — Preserve DCO; contributor/admin Submit rules; proposal, feature-driver, and service-user ACLs; active LLM-Review and Verified requirements; disabled inherited Code-Review; exact vote-copy asymmetry; and Rebase-If-Necessary with `mergeContent=true`. Never describe LLM-Review as the sole gate.
- `register-deploy-key.sh` — Preserve operator-only GitHub mutation, public-key inputs, write-enabled key, dry-run, and title-based idempotence. Keep alternative designs out of inline comments.
- `replication.config` — Preserve site placement, project scope, explicit non-force main/tag/change/feature refspecs, `mirror=false`, permission/meta secrecy, finite retry/timeout, persisted queue, auto-reload, and deploy-key consumer.
- `reviewbot-e2e.sh` — Preserve live test-branch mutation, three exits, SSM secrecy, temporary replication refspec, cleanup, integer LLM-vote check, GitHub poll, and opportunistic mirror-lock probe. Do not claim it proves the full current two-vote pipeline; follow-up bug `educated-greasy-smelts` owns that behavior gap.
- `service-user.sh` — Preserve admin-SSH creation, exact existing-account detection, delete/recreate token rotation, SSM overwrite, argument quoting, and surgical `webhooks.config` update. Describe OAuth and header-based `X-Rebar-Token`, not obsolete query-token delivery.
- `setup-ci-service-account.sh` — Preserve admin-SSH provisioning, public-key validation/private-key rejection, SSH-only identity, Service Users membership, duplicate-key idempotence, and operator-owned private-key delivery. Describe deployed OAuth accurately.
- `setup-project.sh` — Preserve declarative config replacement, project/group creation, additive membership, explicit removal, live UUID/name mapping including Registered Users, dry-run diff, and server-level whole-topic exclusion.
- `setup-replication.sh` — Preserve deploy-key-first failure, site copy/mode/ownership, dry-run, opt-in reload versus default restart, kill switch, and add-new-before-remove-old rotation.
- `smoke-check.sh` — Preserve REST and HTTPS-clone bot-token checks, trailing-slash events endpoint, SSM secrecy, accumulated result, and temporary-clone cleanup.
- `webhooks.config` — Preserve committed secret-free template, refs/meta/config source, internal URL, `X-Rebar-Token`, patchset/comment events, retries, and rerender requirement; the secret is not URL-embedded.

Consumers are Gerrit/plugins, gerrit-to-platform, deployment scripts, runbooks, CI workflows, and operators named by each file.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The leaf commit changes only standalone comments or blank lines in the 17 declared files.
- [ ] Every Scope constraint and consumer contract has a PASS row with concrete before/after citations in a leaf-linked session log authored by a reviewer who did not write the remediation.
- [ ] Every edited comment block has an independent `bloat-removal` PASS row confirming that redundant, obvious, duplicated, historical, or stale prose was removed while current non-obvious rationale remained.
- [ ] Focused Gerrit/config tests, path-scoped `git diff --check`, and repository lint pass at the leaf commit.
- [ ] No missing or FAIL semantic-preservation row remains at closure.

## Verification
Run the recorded comment-only guard, config/shell validation, focused Gerrit tests, path-scoped diff check, and worktree-venv lint. Live E2E claims are not strengthened without an executable oracle.
